paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s 2026 Harvest Walk is scheduled for Tuesday, Oct. 27, starting at 9 a.m. in downtown Pontotoc, according to a notice from Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street.
The Chamber invites anyone who would like to set up a table to hand out candy to call 662-489-5042 to reserve a spot.
